title: PI3K Pathway Inhibition with NVP-BEZ235 Hinders Glycolytic Metabolism in Glioblastoma Multiforme Cells.
authors: Udawant, Shreya; Litif, Carl; Lopez, Alma; Gunn, Bonnie; Schuenzel, Erin; Keniry, Megan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PI3K通路抑制剂对胶质母细胞瘤糖酵解代谢的影响，基于RNA-seq和GSEA分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most lethal primary brain cancer that lacks effective molecular targeted therapies. The PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway is activated in 90% of all Glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) tumors. To gain insight into the impact of the PI3K pathway on GBM metabolism, we treated U87MG GBM cells with NVP-BEZ235 (PI3K and mTOR a dual inhibitor) and identified differentially expressed genes with RNA-seq analysis. RNA-seq identified 7803 differentially regulated genes in response to NVP-BEZ235. Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) identified two glycolysis-related gene sets that were significantly enriched (p < 0.05) in control samples compared to NVP-BEZ235-treated samples. We validated the inhibition of glycolytic genes by NVP-BEZ235 and examined the impact of the FOXO1 inhibitor (AS1842856) on these genes in a set of GBM cell lines. FOXO1 inhibition alone was associated with reduced LDHA expression, but not ENO1 or PKM2. Bioinformatics analyses revealed that PI3K-impacted glycolytic genes were over-expressed and co-expressed in GBM clinical samples. The elevated expression of PI3K-impacted glycolytic genes was associated with poor prognosis in GBM based on Kaplan-Meier survival analyses. Our results suggest novel insights into hallmark metabolic reprogramming associated with the PI3K-mTOR dual inhibition.
abstract_zh: 胶质母细胞瘤（Glioblastoma, GBM）是最致命的一种原发性脑癌，目前缺乏有效的分子靶向治疗手段。PI3K/AKT/mTOR信号通路在90%的胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）肿瘤中被激活。为了深入了解PI3K通路对GBM代谢的影响，我们用NVP-BEZ235（一种PI3K和mTOR双重抑制剂）处理U87MG GBM细胞，并通过RNA-seq分析鉴定差异表达基因。RNA-seq分析发现，响应NVP-BEZ235处理有7803个差异调控基因。基因集富集分析（Gene Set Enrichment Analysis, GSEA）识别出两个与糖酵解相关的基因集，在对照组样本中相较于NVP-BEZ235处理组显著富集（p < 0.05）。我们验证了NVP-BEZ235对糖酵解基因的抑制作用，并在一组GBM细胞系中检测了FOXO1抑制剂（AS1842856）对这些基因的影响。单独抑制FOXO1与LDHA表达降低相关，但对ENO1或PKM2无影响。生物信息学分析显示，受PI3K影响的糖酵解基因在GBM临床样本中过表达且共表达。基于Kaplan-Meier生存分析，受PI3K影响的糖酵解基因的高表达与GBM不良预后相关。我们的结果提示，PI3K-mTOR双重抑制相关的标志性代谢重编程具有新的见解。
